description: List Instagram comment rules with their trigger words, message, on/off setting and confirmed number sent. A rule with `dms` needs the user: `dms.state` "off" means Instagram refused a DM because the account's "Allow access to messages" switch is off (`dms.waiting` replies are held and go out on their own within 15 minutes of turning it on); "check" means the account has not sent a DM yet, so ask the user to make sure the switch is on. Give them `dms.fix` as it is.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: autoreplies_list
title: List Instagram auto-replies
